_doc: Pass 2 of scripts/store-bundle-check.mjs: a UI string in the STORE build that has a STORE_BANNED_WORDS word is allowed only if it contains `match` (case-sensitive) or matches the regex `pattern` in a chunk named `chunk` (file name without Vite's hash; '*' = any). Every entry needs a reason. A reason states a checked fact: the gate that keeps the text from a store user, a false positive, or a reviewed decision. No entry is left open for a later wording decision (round A7, 16 Nov 2026).

allow.match: Cannot buy BSV-20 token listing through ordinal purchase
allow.reason: Library text: @1sat/actions purchase guard error. Thrown only inside a purchase; a store build has no Market, and buyOpnsListing and the agent buy action refuse (A8, S6).

Library text: @1sat/templates OrdLock v2 contract builder errors (seller, payout and index name the contract's script slots). Thrown only while a listing transaction is being built or checked; technical text, not an offer.

Unreachable library text (A9): @1sat/permission-module enrichIntent builds these titles only for an action it classifies as a purchase, listing or cancelled listing, and only to show a site's request on its sheet (the wallet's own actions build none). In a store build every site createAction passes services/storeMarketGate.ts first (wrapped outermost on the site wallet in initWallet.ts), which runs this same enrichIntent and refuses those kinds and steps, and any OrdLock, with 'Not available in this edition' before the module runs. storeGatesA9.test.ts shows it with the real module: no sheet is built. The module stays in the bundle for transfers, inscriptions, locks and names, so its text can't be tree-shaken out without patching the package.

Unreachable library text (A9): the copy of @1sat/permission-module enrichIntent in the store check's own chunk (services/storeMarketGate.ts, loaded by handleSiteCall before Face ID and by the wallet-side backstop). There it only classifies a site's request: storeMarketRefusal keeps the kind and drops the summary and titles, so nothing it builds is ever shown. The module's own sheets are covered by the 'background' entry above.

allow.reason: Unreachable in a store build: purchase checks (p2p/verify.ts verifyPurchaseArgs / verifyOrdinalPurchaseArgs) run only inside a purchase. In the store bundle their one caller is the agent buy path (agents/agentTrade.ts), which agentPairing refuses in a store build (A8, S6) and CliPairConfirm never grants (no trade scope).

False positive: 'Backing up' (wallet backups to a USB key or to all accounts).

Not shown in a store build: the artist-lock label is set only when backArtist is set, and backArtist needs ARTIST_PROGRAMME_ENABLED, which is false in a store build (LockScreen.tsx). The pot name says 'Locked for' in a store build (pots.ts).

productName.reason: On-chain id, not app wording: a bAvatar's inscribed name is '$handle · bWalletX #n' (mintBavatar.ts bavatarLabel), and pictureSource.ts isBavatarItem finds the collection by exactly that text. A store-minted bAvatar named '· bWallet #n' would drop out of the collection. Kept for the owner to decide (store-gates-a9.md).

On-chain content, not app wording: the bAvatar artwork's caption 'bWalletX #n', inscribed into the SVG with the name above (mintBavatar.ts). Same collection identity as the name. Kept for the owner to decide (store-gates-a9.md).

On-chain metadata, not app wording: the bAvatar edition field ('Founding 1,000' or 'bWalletX', mintBavatar.ts) written into the inscription's MAP. Same collection identity as the name. Kept for the owner to decide (store-gates-a9.md).

Inside the b+x glyph SVG file (mobile/brand/bwalletx-glyph.svg), which is only ever used as an (UnlockMark, ObsidianHero, WideShell, JustBIntro) with its own alt; an does not expose the SVG's inner aria-label, so it is never read or shown.

Signed protocol text: names/existingToken.ts importChallenge, the exact message the identity key signs to import a token, which the name server checks byte for byte. Changing it per edition would break the import.
Protocol id: airdrops/note.ts NOTE_APP, the MAP 'app' field written on and matched in airdrop notes on chain (note.ts parse: d.MAP.app !== NOTE_APP). Not shown to the user.
